title: Fix typos in comments and docstrings
body:
Stack from [ghstack](https://github.com/ezyang/ghstack/tree/0.15.0) (oldest at bottom):
* __->__ #186234

Correct a batch of spelling mistakes in source comments, docstrings, and
log messages across torch. These are documentation-only changes with no
effect on behavior.

Authored with Claude (typo_terminator2).
